agentUtterance.text: I found 2 appointments on your order. One is for your Internet and Television services on Thursday, April 30 between 12 PM and 5 PM. The next is for your Wireline service on Friday, May 29 between 8 AM and 12 PM. And remember, a technician can arrive 5 minutes before the end of the appointment and finish later.

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: The user is inquiring about their scheduled service appointments. The system has already retrieved the appointment data and stored it in the {merged_calendar_context} parameter as a JSON array. The user's language preference is stored in the {language} parameter. The agent now needs to process this technical data into a human-readable summary and present it to the user.

playbookOutput.executionSummary: The agent analyzes the {merged_calendar_context} to count appointments and iterates through each object to extract and transform the line of business, date, and time into a 12-hour format without leading zeros. It aggregates all extracted services into the {line_of_business_multiple} parameter and displays the formatted appointment details and technician disclaimer to the user in their preferred language.
